name: letshare
description: P2P file sharing — Internet and LAN modes

scripts.dev:internet: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/internet/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/internet/frontend"
scripts.dev:lan: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/lan/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/lan/frontend"
scripts.dev:all: concurrently "npm run dev -w apps/internet/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/internet/frontend" "npm run dev -w apps/lan/backend" "npm run dev -w apps/lan/frontend"
scripts.build:all: npm run build:internet && npm run build:lan
